special_abilities.name: Quartz Camouflage (Ex)
special_abilities.desc: Translucent quartz facets across the stalker's body bend ambient light and fracture shadows. While remaining motionless against stone or crystalline surfaces, the stalker gains a +8 racial bonus on Stealth checks and can make Stealth checks while clinging to bare stone walls even without cover or concealment.

special_abilities.name: Crystalline Refraction (Su)
special_abilities.desc: The creature's translucent quartz shell bends incoming magical beams. Directly targeted ray attacks and ranged touch spells suffer a 20% miss chance against the quartz stalker.

special_abilities.name: Brittle Resonance (Ex)
special_abilities.desc: Like all quartz-based organisms, the stalker is vulnerable to sonic damage. If it takes 15 or more sonic damage from a single attack, the harmonic reverberation fractures its internal matrix, leaving it dazed for 1 round.

Name: Quartz Rhinoceros
Senses: darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 60 ft., low-light vision, scent, Perception +12
SpecialAttacks: monolithic gore, shattering charge, siege engine, trample (2d8+15, DC 26)
Feats: Awesome Blow, Greater Bull Rush, Greater Sunder, Improved Bull Rush, Improved Sunder, Power Attack
Skills: Perception +12
Environment: subterranean crystal chasms, deep quartz quarries, rocky plateaus
Special Abilities:
Shattering Charge (Ex) When the rhinoceros charges, the massive quartz monolith on its snout strikes with catastrophic kinetic force. If its gore attack hits at the end of a charge, it deals 6d8+30 points of damage. The struck creature must succeed on a DC 26 Fortitude save or be knocked prone and dazed for 1 round. The terrain along the 10-foot-wide path of the charge shatters into jagged crystalline debris, turning into difficult terrain for 1 minute. The save DC is Strength-based.
Siege Engine (Ex) The quartz rhinoceros's gore and trample attacks deal double damage against objects and structures, bypassing the first 10 points of the target's hardness.
Monolithic Gore (Ex) The creature's horn is a dense, jagged pillar of uncut solid quartz. This attack has a x3 critical multiplier and threatens a critical hit on a roll of 19-20. Additionally, its gore attacks bypass DR/adamantine and DR/magic.
Quartz Refraction (Su) The dense layers of prismatic quartz plates across its flank refract incoming magical energy and light. Directly targeted ray attacks and ranged touch spells suffer a 20% miss chance against the rhinoceros.
Brittle Resonance (Ex) Like all quartz-based organisms, the rhinoceros is vulnerable to sonic damage. If it takes 20 or more sonic damage from a single attack, the harmonic reverberation fractures the internal crystalline matrix of its plates, reducing its natural armor bonus by 4 and preventing it from using the charge action for 1d4 rounds.
